title: Muhallinmu
description: Ten short stories about the environment in daily life: a water channel blocked by rubbish in Zaria, a student watching elephants at Yankari, a birthday party with borrowed calabashes instead of plastic in Gombe, sanitation day at a shop in Kaduna, a pasture lost to sand near Tahoua in Niger, a Friday sermon on trees in Gusau, a folk tale of a princess and a tortoise who save a forest, a reporter finding the real cause of a farmers' and herders' clash in Bauchi, a tailor in a wheelchair in a renewed Kano market, and an old wrestler who planted trees along the river at Hadejia.

lessons.title: Hanyar ruwa ta toshe
lessons.summary: In Zaria, rubbish blocks the water channel in front of Iklima and Abdulhadi's house; a night of rain floods the street, spoils her washing and leaves a car stuck in the mud; the authorities are slow to come, so Abdulhadi and the young men of the quarter dig a new channel themselves, and the council workers finish it with them.
lessons.text:
Iklima tana zaune da mijinta Abdulhadi a wata unguwa a Zaria. A gaban gidansu akwai wata hanyar ruwa da take kai ruwan sama zuwa kogi. Amma mutanen unguwar sukan zuba shara da leda a cikinta, har ta toshe.

Wata rana da daddare, aka fara ruwan sama mai ƙarfi. Ruwan bai samu hanyar wucewa ba, saboda hanyar ruwa ta toshe. Sai ya hau titi, ya shiga gidaje. Da safe Iklima ta fito, ta ga cewa ruwa ya shiga tsakar gidanta, ya ɓata wankin da ta yi a jiya. Ta ce wa mijinta, "Wankin kwana biyu ya lalace!"

A kan titi, motar wani maƙwabci ta makale a cikin ruwa da laka. Mutane suka tura ta, amma ta ƙi fita.

Abdulhadi shi ne shugaban ƙungiyar matasan unguwar. Ya ce, "Wannan matsala ba za ta ƙare ba sai mun gana da mahukunta." Da safe ya tafi ofishin ƙaramar hukuma, ya gana da wani jami'i. Jami'in ya ce masa cewa mahukunta sun san matsalar, kuma za su turo ma'aikata nan da mako guda.

Amma aka yi jinkiri. Mako ɗaya ya wuce, na biyu ya wuce, babu wanda ya zo. Wannan jinkirin ya kawo cikas ga rayuwar mutanen unguwar: yara ba sa iya zuwa makaranta, 'yan kasuwa ba sa iya buɗe shagunansu.

Sai Abdulhadi ya tara matasan unguwar, ya ce musu, "Ba za mu zauna muna jiran mahukunta ba. Kowa ya yi aiki gwargwadon ƙarfinsa." Wasu matasa suka kawo kayan aiki, wasu suka kawo kuɗi gwargwadon abin da suke da shi. Suka fitar da sharar da ta toshe hanyar ruwa, sannan suka haƙa wata sabuwar hanya daga ƙarshen titin zuwa kogi.

Bayan kwana uku, sai ga ma'aikatan ƙaramar hukuma sun zo. Da suka ga aikin da matasan suka yi, suka yi mamaki. Suka taimaka musu suka gama haƙa hanyar. Wani jami'i ya ce, "Ku yi haƙuri da jinkirin da muka yi. Mun gode da ƙoƙarinku."

Bayan haka Abdulhadi ya gana da masu gidajen unguwar, suka yarda cewa babu wanda zai sake zuba shara a cikin hanyar ruwa. Mako na gaba, da daddare aka sake yin ruwan sama mai ƙarfi. Wannan karon ruwan ya bi hanyarsa zuwa kogi. Babu motar da ta makale, kuma wankin Iklima ya bushe lafiya.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa hanyar ruwa ta toshe?
Ta toshe ne saboda mutanen unguwar sukan zuba shara da leda a cikinta.
Me ya faru da wankin Iklima?
Ruwa ya shiga tsakar gidanta, ya ɓata wankin da ta yi.
Da wa Abdulhadi ya gana a ofishin ƙaramar hukuma?
Ya gana da wani jami'i.
Me jinkirin mahukunta ya kawo?
Ya kawo cikas ga rayuwar mutanen unguwar.
Me matasan suka yi?
Sun fitar da sharar, suka haƙa sabuwar hanyar ruwa zuwa kogi.

lessons.title: Giwayen Yankari
lessons.summary: Nasra, a university student of the environment in Kano, visits the Yankari reserve in Bauchi to see elephants for the first time; the guide Malam Saifullahi tells her the park is a refuge and that they must keep silent, and she stares in wonder as a herd crosses a river, a mother helping her calf.
lessons.text:
Nasra ɗaliba ce a jami'a a Kano, kuma tana karatu game da muhalli. A lokacin hutu ta tafi gandun dajin Yankari a jihar Bauchi, domin ta ga giwaye da idonta. Ta daɗe tana karanta labarin giwaye a littattafai, amma ba ta taɓa ganin giwa ba.

A Yankari, wani jagora mai suna Malam Saifullahi ya same ta a ƙofar dajin. Ya ce mata, "Wannan daji mafaka ce ga dabbobi. A wasu wurare mutane sun sare dazuzzuka, suna farautar dabbobi. Amma a nan babu mai farautarsu. Shi ya sa giwaye suka samu mafaka a nan."

Da safe suka hau wata mota, suka zagaya cikin dajin. Malam Saifullahi ya ce, "Idan mun ga giwaye, sai mu yi shuru. Giwa tana jin ƙara daga nesa sosai." Suka zagaya awa ɗaya ba su ga komai ba sai birai da tsuntsaye.

Sai suka iso bakin wani kogi. A ɗaya gefen kogin akwai gungun giwaye goma sha biyu, manya da ƙanana. Malam Saifullahi ya tsayar da motar, ya ɗaga hannu, ya ce, "Shuru!" Nasra ta zura ido tana kallonsu. Ba ta motsa ba, ko da daƙiƙa ɗaya. Wata babbar giwa ta ɗaga kai, ta kalli motar na tsawon daƙiƙa goma, sannan ta juya.

Sai gungun giwayen ya fara tsallaka kogin. Manya suna gaba, ƙanana suna tsakiya. Wata ƙaramar giwa ta kusa faɗuwa a cikin ruwan, sai uwarta ta tallafa mata da jikinta. Nasra ta ce a hankali, "Wannan al'ajabi ne!"

Malam Saifullahi ya bayyana mata cewa fatar giwa tana da kauri sosai. "Amma duk da kaurin fatarta, giwa tana jin zafin rana. Shi ya sa giwaye suke son ruwa da laka. Bayan sun tsallaka kogi, sukan shafa wa jikinsu laka."

Da giwayen suka gama tsallaka kogin, suka shiga cikin itatuwa. Nasra ta ci gaba da zura ido har sai da ta daina ganinsu. Sai ta lura cewa ba ta yi magana ba tsawon minti ashirin. Malam Saifullahi ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Ban taɓa ganin baƙo mai shuru kamar ke ba!"

Da yamma, kafin ta koma Kano, Nasra ta rubuta a littafinta: "Yau na ga gungun giwaye suna tsallaka kogi. Na ga al'ajabi da idona. Dole mu kare wannan mafaka, domin idan ta ɓace, giwaye ba za su samu wani wuri ba."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Nasra ta je Yankari?
Ta je ne domin ta ga giwaye da idonta.
Me ya sa Malam Saifullahi ya ce dajin mafaka ne?
Saboda a can babu mai farautar dabbobi.
Me ya sa suka yi shuru?
Sun yi shuru ne saboda giwa tana jin ƙara daga nesa.
Me Nasra ta gani a bakin kogi?
Ta ga gungun giwaye goma sha biyu suna tsallaka kogin.
Yaya fatar giwa take?
Fatar giwa tana da kauri sosai.

lessons.title: Fatin Bushira
lessons.summary: In Gombe, Basma plans a birthday party for her little sister Bushira; their mother allows it on condition that no plastic plates or cups are used, so Basma borrows calabashes from the neighbours, bakes a cake with sugar, keeps the flies off with a net, and returns the washed calabashes the next day.
lessons.text:
Basma tana zaune a Gombe tare da iyayenta da ƙanwarta Bushira. Bushira za ta cika shekara bakwai a ranar Asabar. Basma ta ce wa mahaifiyarsu, "Ina so in shirya wa ƙanwata fatin ranar haihuwa."

Mahaifiyarsu ta ce, "To, amma da sharaɗi ɗaya: ba za a yi amfani da kwanoni ko kofunan roba ba. A fatin da aka yi a gidan maƙwabtanmu a watan jiya, an zubar da robobi da yawa a titi."

Basma ta yi tunani, sai ta ce, "Zan ari ƙwarya daga wurin maƙwabtanmu. Za mu zuba abinci da abin sha a cikin ƙwarya, kamar yadda kakanninmu suka yi."

Ranar Juma'a, Basma ta bi gidajen maƙwabta tana neman aro. Hajiya mai gidan gaba ta ce, "Ga ƙwarya biyar, ki ari su." Wata mace a gidan gefe ta ba ta wasu shida. Kafin yamma, Basma ta ari ƙwarya goma sha biyar. Ta ce wa kowace mace, "Gobe da yamma zan dawo da su."

Sannan ta fara tanada kayan fatin. Ta tanada shinkafa da kaza, ta tanada lemu da ruwan sanyi. Mahaifiyarsu ta taimaka mata ta gasa babban kek. Suka zuba gari da ƙwai da sukari, kuma suka sa madara kaɗan a ciki. Bushira tana son kek mai zaƙi, saboda haka suka ƙara sukari.

Washegari da rana, baƙi suka fara zuwa. Basma ta zuba madara mai sanyi a cikin ƙananan ƙwarya, ta ba kowane yaro guda. Amma da ta ajiye kek ɗin a kan tebur a waje, sai ƙudaje suka fara zuwa. Ƙuda yana son sukari sosai. Basma ta ce, "Kada ƙuda ya taɓa kek ɗin ƙanwata!" Sai ta rufe kek ɗin da wata raga mai laushi, har ƙudajen suka tafi.

Da aka yanka kek ɗin, kowa ya ci ya yaba. Bushira ta rungumi yayarta, ta ce, "Wannan fatin ya fi duk fatin da na taɓa gani!" Basma ma ta rungume ta, ta ce, "Ina son ki, ƙanwata."

Bayan baƙi sun tafi, babu robobi a ƙasa ko a titi. Basma ta wanke kowace ƙwarya. Washegari da yamma ta mayar da su ga maƙwabtan da ta ara daga wurinsu, ta ce musu, "Na gode da kuka ba ni aro."

Tambayoyi:
Me Basma take so ta yi wa ƙanwarta?
Tana so ta shirya mata fatin ranar haihuwa.
Wane sharaɗi mahaifiyarsu ta sa?
Ta ce ba za a yi amfani da kwanoni ko kofunan roba ba.
Ƙwarya nawa Basma ta ara?
Ta ari ƙwarya goma sha biyar daga wurin maƙwabta.
Me suka sa a cikin kek ɗin?
Suka sa gari da ƙwai da sukari, da madara kaɗan.
Me Basma ta yi da ƙudaje suka zo?
Ta rufe kek ɗin da raga mai laushi, har ƙudajen suka tafi.

lessons.title: Ranar tsaftar muhalli
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, the last Saturday of each month is marked on the state calendar as sanitation day; Mujahid, who works in Hajiya Kaltumi's shop, comes late, spits on the ground and looks down on the old sweeper Malam Rufa'i; the old man teaches him that no task is too small, and Mujahid apologises and sweeps with him.
lessons.text:
A Kaduna, a cikin kalandar gwamnatin jihar, Asabar ta ƙarshe ta kowane wata ranar tsaftar muhalli ce. A wannan rana, daga ƙarfe bakwai zuwa ƙarfe goma na safe, ba a buɗe kanti ko kasuwa ba. Kowa yana share gaban gidansa da gaban shagonsa.

Hajiya Kaltumi tana da wani kanti a bakin babban titi. Ta rataye kalanda a bangon kantin. 'Yarta Hamra tana taimaka mata, tare da wani matashi mai suna Mujahid, wanda yake aiki a kantin.

A ranar tsaftar muhalli ta wannan wata, Hamra ta zo da wuri, ta fara share gaban kantin. Hajiya Kaltumi ta ce mata, "Hamra, ba kya gajiya? Ki huta kaɗan." Hamra ta ce, "Ba na gajiya, Mama. Amma ina Mujahid?"

Mujahid ya makara. Ya iso bayan ƙarfe takwas da rabi, kuma a bakin ƙofar kantin ya tofa yawu a ƙasa. Hajiya Kaltumi ta ce, "Mujahid, ka makara, kuma kana tofa yawu a gaban kantina? Ba ka san cewa yawu yana ɗauke da cututtuka ba?"

A wannan lokacin, wani dattijo mai suna Malam Rufa'i yana share titi kusa da su. Mujahid ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Ai share titi aikin talakawa ne. Ni ba zan yi irin wannan aiki ba." Ta haka ya raina aikin dattijon a gabansa.

Hamra ta ce, "Mujahid, ba ka jin kunya? Ina ladabinka?" Malam Rufa'i ya ajiye tsintsiyarsa, ya ce a hankali, "Ɗana, kada ka raina wani aiki saboda ƙanƙantarsa. Yawu ma, duk da ƙanƙantarsa, yana iya yaɗa cuta. Idan babu masu share titi, gari zai cika da datti. Ladabi shi ne mutum ya girmama kowa."

Mujahid ya yi shuru na ɗan lokaci. Sannan ya furta abin da ke zuciyarsa: "Baba, ka yi mini gafara. Na yi kuskure." Ya juya ga Hajiya Kaltumi, ya sake furta, "Hajiya, ina neman gafara da na makara, kuma na tofa yawu a ƙasa."

Hajiya Kaltumi ta ce, "Allah ya yafe mana duka." Malam Rufa'i ya juya ga Hamra, ya ce, "'Yata, ke kuma ba kya tsoron datti. Kin yi aiki tun da safe." Sannan ya yi murmushi, ya ba Mujahid wata tsintsiya. Har ƙarfe goma, matashin da dattijon suka share titin tare. Da aka buɗe kantin,

Tambayoyi:
Wace rana ce ranar tsaftar muhalli a Kaduna?
Asabar ta ƙarshe ta kowane wata, kamar yadda yake a kalandar gwamnatin jihar.
Me Mujahid ya yi da ya iso?
Ya makara, kuma ya tofa yawu a ƙasa a bakin ƙofar kantin.
Yaya Mujahid ya raina Malam Rufa'i?
Ya ce share titi aikin talakawa ne.
Me Malam Rufa'i ya koya masa?
Ya koya masa cewa kada ya raina wani aiki saboda ƙanƙantarsa.
Me Mujahid ya furta?
Ya furta cewa ya yi kuskure, kuma ya nemi gafara.

lessons.title: Makiyayar Tahoua
lessons.summary: Near Tahoua in Niger, the herder Boubacar watches the pasture shrink as sand covers it and wood traders with sharp axes cut the trees; at a meeting the forestry officer Halidou speaks French and Boubacar's daughter Aissata translates; the villagers plant trees in half-moon pits and guard them, and after two rainy seasons grass returns.
lessons.text:
Boubacar mai kiwon shanu ne, kuma yana zaune a wani ƙauye kusa da Tahoua, a ƙasar Nijar. Shekaru goma da suka wuce, akwai wata babbar makiyaya kusa da ƙauyensu, mai ciyawa da itatuwa. Shanunsa da tumakinsa suna kiwo a cikinta duk shekara.

Amma yanzu yashi yana rufe makiyayar. Kowace shekara iska tana kawo yashi daga arewa, kuma ciyawa ba ta tsiro a kan yashi. Lamarin ya munana sosai. Boubacar ya ce wa matarsa, "Muna cikin mawuyacin hali. Babu isasshen ruwan sha ga mutane, ɓalle ga shanu."

Wani dalili kuma shi ne fataucin itace. Wasu mutane daga gari suna zuwa da gatura masu kaifi, suna sare itatuwan makiyayar, suna kai su kasuwa domin sayarwa. Wannan fatauci yana kawo musu kuɗi, amma yana kashe makiyayar. Kaifin gaturansu ya sa itace ɗaya yana faɗuwa cikin minti kaɗan.

Wata rana wani jami'in gandun daji mai suna Halidou ya zo ƙauyen. Mutane suka taru a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya domin su ji shi. Halidou ya fara magana da Faransanci, saboda shi ne harshen ofis a Nijar. Yawancin mutanen ƙauyen ba sa jin Faransanci, ɓalle su fahimci kalmomin aikin gandun daji. Sai 'yar Boubacar, Aissata, wadda take koyon Faransanci a makaranta, ta tashi ta fassara musu.

Halidou ya ce, "Matsalar ba gazawar ruwan sama kaɗai ba ce. Gazawarmu ce ma, domin mun bar mutane suna sare itatuwa. Idan muna so mu sami maganin dindindin, dole mu dasa itatuwa, mu kare su." Aissata ta fassara kowace magana daga Faransanci zuwa Hausa.

Mutanen ƙauyen suka yarda. Halidou ya koya musu yadda ake haƙa ramuka masu siffar rabin wata, domin ruwan sama ya tsaya a cikinsu. Suka dasa itatuwa a cikin ramukan. Matasa suka riƙa tsaron makiyayar dare da rana, suka hana masu fataucin itace shiga.

Bayan damina biyu, ciyawa ta fara tsirowa a wurin da yashi ya rufe a da. Itatuwan sun yi tsawo, kuma iska ba ta kawo yashi da yawa kamar a da. Boubacar ya ce, "Mun kusa fita daga mawuyacin halin da muke ciki. Rayuwa ba ta zama mai sauƙi ba tukuna, amma yanzu muna da fata. Wannan ne maganin dindindin."

Tambayoyi:
Me yake rufe makiyayar Tahoua?
Yashi ne yake rufe makiyayar.
Yaya lamarin yake a ƙauyen Boubacar?
Lamarin ya munana, kuma mutanen ƙauyen suna cikin mawuyacin hali.
Me masu fataucin itace suke yi?
Suna sare itatuwa da gatura masu kaifi, suna kai su kasuwa.
Me ya sa Aissata ta fassara maganar Halidou?
Saboda yawancin mutanen ƙauyen ba sa jin Faransanci, ɓalle su fahimci kalmomin gandun daji.
Wane magani ne na dindindin Halidou ya faɗa?
Ya ce gazawar ruwan sama ba ita kaɗai ce matsalar ba, kuma dole su dasa itatuwa, su kare su.

lessons.title: Huɗubar Malam Abdulfatah
lessons.summary: In Gusau, the young firewood seller Haisam hears Imam Abdulfatah's Friday sermon on trees: a tree planted brings reward even in the afterlife, rain is God's mercy on all humankind whether believer or unbeliever, and cutting every tree is harm; Haisam drops his claim that one man's axe changes nothing and plants trees instead.
lessons.text:
Haisam matashi ne a Gusau, a jihar Zamfara. Yana sayar da itacen girki a kasuwa. Kowace safiya yakan fita daji da gatarinsa, ya sare itatuwa, ya ɗauko itace a kan jakinsa.

Wata Juma'a, Haisam ya je masallaci. Limamin masallacin, Malam Abdulfatah, ya fara huɗubarsa da cewa, "Jigon huɗubarmu ta yau shi ne itace da ruwa." Haisam ya yi mamaki, domin bai taɓa jin huɗuba game da itace ba.

Malam Abdulfatah ya ce, "Duk wanda ya dasa itace, yana samun lada. Idan tsuntsu ya ci 'ya'yan itacen, mai shi yana samun lada. Har bayan mutuwarsa, ladar tana ci gaba, har zuwa lahira. Wanda ya dasa itace ya ajiye wa kansa wani abu a lahira."

Sai ya ci gaba: "Ruwan sama rahama ne daga Allah. Wannan rahama tana sauka ga dukan bil'adama. Ruwan sama ba ya bambanta tsakanin musulmi da kafiri. Yana sauka a gonar musulmi, yana sauka a gonar kafiri. Bil'adama duka suna da nauyin kula da ƙasar da Allah ya ba su."

Daga nan ya yi magana game da sharri: "Sare itace ɗaya domin girki ba laifi ba ne. Amma sare duk itatuwan daji sharri ne. Idan babu itatuwa, ƙasa za ta bushe, iska za ta kawo ƙura, kuma ruwan sama zai ragu. Wannan sharrin zai shafi 'ya'yanmu da jikokinmu."

Bayan sallah, Haisam ya je wurin limamin. Ya ce, "Malam, ni ina sayar da itace. Amma ina da da'awa: ni mutum ɗaya ne, gatarina ɗaya ne. Ta yaya zan iya lalata daji?" Malam Abdulfatah ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "Wannan da'awa ba gaskiya ba ce. Idan ka sare itace goma a mako, ka ga itace ɗari biyar a shekara. Idan masu sayar da itace ɗari suka yi haka, ballantana dubu, me zai rage a daji?"

Haisam ya yi shuru, ya yi tunani. Sannan ya ce, "Malam, ba zan iya barin sana'ata yau ba. Ba ni da wata sana'a, ballantana kuɗin fara wata. Amma daga yau, duk itacen da na sare, zan dasa biyu a madadinsa."

Bayan shekara biyu, Haisam yana da wani ƙaramin gandun itatuwa a bayan ƙauyensu. Ya ce wa abokansa, "Na samu kuɗi a duniya, kuma ina fatan samun lada a lahira."

Tambayoyi:
Wane ne jigon huɗubar Malam Abdulfatah?
Jigon huɗubarsa shi ne itace da ruwa.
Me mai dasa itace yake samu?
Yana samun lada, har zuwa lahira.
Me ya sa limamin ya ce ruwan sama rahama ne ga dukan bil'adama?
Saboda yana sauka a gonar musulmi da ta kafiri.
Wace da'awa Haisam ya yi?
Ya ce shi mutum ɗaya ne, gatarinsa ɗaya ne, ba zai iya lalata daji ba.
Me Haisam ya yi alƙawari zai yi?
Ya ce duk itacen da ya sare, zai dasa biyu a madadinsa.

lessons.title: Gimbiya Fatsuma da kunkuru
lessons.summary: A folk tale: Princess Fatsuma slips by a pond in a forest where people say a ghost lives, and her ring falls into the water; a tortoise brings it back and tells her there is no ghost, only animals, and asks her to save the forest the king plans to clear; at dawn she asks her father on his throne, he agrees, and the people praise her.
lessons.text:
A zamanin da, akwai wani sarki mai hikima. Yana zaune a kan ƙaragarsa a cikin babban fada. Yana da 'ya ɗaya, Gimbiya Fatsuma. Mahaifiyarta ta ba ta wani zobe na zinare, kuma tana son wannan zobe sosai.

Kusa da garin akwai wani daji mai itatuwa masu yawa, kuma a tsakiyarsa akwai wani ƙaramin tafki. Mutanen garin suna cewa wata fatalwa tana zaune a cikin dajin, saboda haka ba sa shiga cikinsa. Amma wata rana sarki ya ce, "Garinmu ya yi girma. Zan sare dajin nan domin mu gina sababbin gidaje."

Gimbiya Fatsuma ta ji haka, sai ta yi baƙin ciki. Tana so ta ga dajin kafin a sare shi. Ita kaɗai ta shiga cikinsa, ta tafi bakin tafkin. Ba ta ga wata fatalwa ba. Amma da ta taka wani dutse a bakin ruwan, sai ƙafarta ta zame. Ba ta faɗa ba, amma zobenta ya zame daga yatsanta, ya faɗa cikin tafkin.

Gimbiya ta zauna a bakin tafkin, tana kuka. Hawaye suna zuba a kan kuncinta. Sai wani kunkuru ya fito daga cikin ruwan. A bakinsa akwai zobenta!

Kunkurun ya ce, "Gimbiya, ga zobenki. Na gan shi a ƙasan ruwa." Gimbiya ta goge hawayen da ke kan kuncinta, ta karɓi zobenta, ta ce, "Na gode, kunkuru. Amma kana tsoron fatalwar dajin nan?" Kunkurun ya ce, "Babu wata fatalwa a nan. Ni da sauran dabbobi ne muke zaune a dajin nan. Idan aka sare shi, ba mu da wani wuri. Don Allah ki roƙi mahaifinki ya bar mana shi."

Gimbiya ta koma gida. Da aka wayi gari, ta je fada. Sarki yana zaune a kan ƙaragarsa. Ta faɗa masa duk abin da ya faru, ta nuna masa zobenta. Sarki ya shafa haɓarsa, ya yi tunani na ɗan lokaci. Sannan ya ce, "Kunkuru ya mayar miki da zobenki. Ba zan mayar masa da sharri ba. Ba za a sare dajin ba. Za mu gina sababbin gidaje a wani wuri."

Mutanen gari suka yi murna. Suka jinjina wa gimbiya, suka ce, "Gimbiya Fatsuma ta ceci dajinmu!" Tun daga wannan rana, babu mai cewa fatalwa tana cikin dajin. Kowace safiya, idan aka wayi gari, gimbiya takan je bakin tafkin ta ziyarci abokinta kunkuru.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa mutane ba sa shiga cikin dajin?
Suna cewa wata fatalwa tana zaune a cikinsa.
Yaya zoben gimbiya ya faɗa cikin tafkin?
Ƙafarta ta zame, sai zobenta ya zame daga yatsanta ya faɗa cikin ruwa.
Wa ya mayar mata da zobenta?
Wani kunkuru ne ya fito da zobenta daga cikin tafkin.
Me sarki ya yi kafin ya amsa?
Ya shafa haɓarsa, ya yi tunani.
Me mutanen gari suka yi wa gimbiya?
Sun jinjina mata, suka ce ta ceci dajinsu.

lessons.title: Rahoton Mubina
lessons.summary: In Bauchi, the radio reporter Mubina covers the swearing-in of Governor Abdulmutallib after the Supreme Court confirms his election; days later a dispute over a dried pasture stream turns into an attack on a village, which some call tribalism; Mubina checks reliable sources, reports that the real cause is water, and the governor's offer of wells and grazing routes is accepted.
lessons.text:
Mubina 'yar jarida ce a wani gidan rediyo a Bauchi. Bayan zaɓen gwamna, an kai jayayya a kan sakamakon zaɓen har kotun koli. A ƙarshe, kotun koli ta tabbatar da nasarar Gwamna Abdulmutallib. Mubina ta je filin wasa na garin, inda aka rantsar da sabon gwamnan a gaban dubban mutane. Bayan an rantsar da shi, sabon gwamnan da aka rantsar ya ce, "Zan kare rayuwar manoma da masu kiwo duka."

Bayan mako biyu, aka samu wani labari mara daɗi. A wani ƙauye kusa da wani rafi, an yi jayayya tsakanin manoma da masu kiwo. Daga baya jayayyar ta zama farmaki: wasu mutane suka kai farmaki a ƙauyen da daddare, suka ƙona rumbuna, aka raunata mutane uku.

A gidan rediyo, mutane da yawa suka kira, suna cewa wannan rikicin ƙabilanci ne. Wani ya ce, "Ƙabilanci ne ya jawo wannan farmaki!" Amma Mubina ba ta so ta yaɗa labarin da ba ta tabbatar da shi ba. Ta ce wa shugabanta, "Dole in nemi majiya amintacciya."

Ta tafi ƙauyen. Ta yi magana da shugaban manoma, Malam Alkasim, da shugaban masu kiwo, Buba. Ta kuma yi magana da wani jami'in gwamnati wanda yake amintacce a wurin mutanen ƙauyen. Duk majiyoyinta sun faɗi abu ɗaya: haƙiƙanin dalilin rikicin ruwa ne, ba ƙabilanci ba. Rafin da manoma da masu kiwo suke amfani da shi ya kusa bushewa. Manoma suna son ruwan domin gonakinsu, masu kiwo suna son shi domin shanunsu.

Malam Alkasim ya ce mata, "Mun fidda rai. Babu wanda yake saurarenmu." Buba ma ya ce, "Mu ma mun kusa fidda rai."

Mubina ta yi rahotonta a rediyo. Ta ce, "Bisa ga majiyoyi amintattu, haƙiƙanin abin da ya jawo farmakin shi ne ƙarancin ruwa." Gwamna Abdulmutallib ya ji rahoton. Washegari ya tura wakilai zuwa ƙauyen da wani tayi: gwamnati za ta haƙa rijiyoyi biyar, kuma za ta raba gonaki da hanyoyin kiwo.

Manoma da masu kiwo suka taru a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya, suka saurari tayin gwamnan. Malam Alkasim da Buba suka gaisa, suka karɓi tayin. Buba ya ce, "Yau mun ga haƙiƙanin zaman lafiya."

Tambayoyi:
Wace kotu ce ta tabbatar da nasarar Gwamna Abdulmutallib?
Kotun koli ce ta tabbatar da nasararsa.
Me ya faru a ƙauyen kusa da rafi?
An yi jayayya tsakanin manoma da masu kiwo, sannan aka kai farmaki a ƙauyen.
Me ya sa Mubina ta je ƙauyen?
Domin ta nemi majiya amintacciya kafin ta yaɗa labarin.
Wane ne haƙiƙanin dalilin rikicin?
Haƙiƙanin dalilin shi ne ƙarancin ruwa, ba ƙabilanci ba.
Wane tayi gwamnan ya yi?
Ya ce gwamnati za ta haƙa rijiyoyi, ta raba gonaki da hanyoyin kiwo, domin kada mutane su fidda rai.

lessons.title: Shagon Abdulwahid
lessons.summary: In Kano, the tailor Abdulwahid, who moves in a wheelchair, is given a new shop upstairs when the market is renewed; the address on his paper confuses him because two shops look exactly alike, and there is no ramp for disabled people; he and the market officer Malama Badiyya get a ramp built and a shop below, and he enjoys sewing there.
lessons.text:
Abdulwahid tela ne a Kano. Tun yana yaro ƙafafunsa ba sa aiki, saboda haka yana tafiya a kan keken nakasassu. Amma hannayensa suna da ƙarfi sosai, kuma tsokar hannayensa ta yi girma saboda yana tura kekensa kowace rana. Yana da ƙwarewa a ɗinki: yana ɗinkin riguna, wanduna da kayan aure.

Shekaru goma yana ɗinki a wani ƙaramin shago a ƙasan wata kasuwa. Amma a bana gwamnati ta sabunta kasuwar. An rushe tsofaffin shaguna, aka gina sababbi masu bene. Bayan an sabunta kasuwar, aka ba Abdulwahid wata takarda mai adireshin sabon shagonsa.

Abdulwahid ya karanta adireshin: "Layi na uku, bene na farko, shago na goma sha bakwai." Da ya isa layi na uku, sai adireshin ya rikita shi. Akwai shaguna biyu masu lamba goma sha bakwai, kuma suna kama da juna kwat da kwat. Ɗaya yana ƙasa, ɗaya yana bene. Bai san wane ne nasa ba.

Babbar matsalar kuma ita ce babu wata hanyar hawa bene sai matakala. Abdulwahid ya ɗaga kai, ya kalli benen. Ko da tsokar hannayensa tana da ƙarfi, ba zai iya hawa matakala da kekensa ba.

Sai ya je ofishin kasuwar, inda ya sami wata jami'a mai suna Malama Badiyya. Ya taƙaita mata matsalarsa: "Adireshin nan ya rikita ni, kuma shagona yana bene. Ni da sauran nakasassu ba mu iya hawa matakala." Malama Badiyya ta ce, "Ka yi gaskiya. Lokacin da aka sabunta kasuwar, an manta da nakasassu."

Malama Badiyya ta duba takardun, ta ga cewa shagunan biyu kwat da kwat suke, amma na ƙasa ba shi da mai shi tukuna. Sai ta ba Abdulwahid shagon da ke ƙasa. Sannan ta rubuta wa mahukuntan kasuwa wasiƙa, ta taƙaita musu bukatun nakasassu a cikin layi biyar. Bayan wata ɗaya, aka gina hanyoyin hawa masu gangara a kowane layi, domin kowa ya iya hawa bene.

Yanzu Abdulwahid yana more sabon shagonsa. Shagon yana da haske, kuma iska tana shiga sosai. Abokan cinikinsa suna more ɗinkinsa kamar a da. Ya ce wa Malama Badiyya, "Kasuwa ta gari ita ce wadda kowa zai iya shiga."

Tambayoyi:
Wane aiki Abdulwahid yake yi?
Yana aikin ɗinki: yana ɗinkin riguna da wanduna.
Me ya sa tsokar hannayensa ta yi girma?
Saboda yana tura keken nakasassu kowace rana.
Me ya sa adireshin ya rikita shi?
Akwai shaguna biyu masu lamba ɗaya, kuma suna kama da juna kwat da kwat.
Me Malama Badiyya ta yi?
Ta ba shi shagon da ke ƙasa, kuma ta rubuta wasiƙa game da bukatun nakasassu.
Yaya Abdulwahid yake ji yanzu?
Yana more sabon shagonsa.

lessons.title: Itatuwan Malam Bagudu
lessons.summary: In Hadejia, the old former wrestler Malam Bagudu has planted lime and other trees along the river all his life; when his granddaughter Ummusalma gives birth he plants a tree for the baby, and he tells his grandson Zaharaddeen to stop sitting at the bar and plant with him; when the old man dies, the people at his funeral each plant a tree by the river.
lessons.text:
Malam Bagudu dattijo ne a Hadejia, a jihar Jigawa. Tun yana matashi ya shahara a kokawa. A kasuwanni da bukukuwan Sallah, mutane suna taruwa domin su kalli kokawarsa. Amma yanzu ya tsufa, kuma jijiyoyi suna bayyane a kan hannayensa.

Kokawa ba ita kaɗai ce abin da Malam Bagudu yake so ba. Duk rayuwarsa yana dasa itatuwa a bakin kogin Hadejia: lemun tsami, mangwaro da dabino. Mutanen gari suna cewa, "Duk itacen lemun tsami da ke bakin kogi, Malam Bagudu ne ya dasa shi."

Wata rana jikarsa Ummusalma ta haihu. Ta haifi ɗa namiji. Da Malam Bagudu ya ji cewa ta haihu, ya yi farin ciki sosai, har hawaye suka fito daga idonsa saboda tsabar murna. Sai ya ɗauki wata ƙaramar bishiyar lemun tsami, ya tafi bakin kogi, ya dasa ta. Ya ce, "Wannan bishiyar jikana ce. Za ta girma tare da shi."

Amma jikansa Zaharaddeen ya dami Malam Bagudu. Zaharaddeen ba ya aiki. Kowace yamma yakan je wata mashaya a bakin tashar mota, ya zauna a can tare da abokansa har dare. Wata rana Malam Bagudu ya kira shi, ya ce, "Jikana, zama a mashaya ba zai kawo maka komai ba. Gara ka zo mu dasa itatuwa tare."

Zaharaddeen ya kalli hannayen kakansa, ya ga jijiyoyin da ke kansu. Ya ce, "Baba, ka tsufa, amma har yanzu kana aiki. Ni kuma ina zaune a mashaya." Daga wannan rana ya daina zuwa mashaya. Kowace safiya yakan bi kakansa bakin kogi, suna dasa itatuwa, suna ba su ruwa.

Bayan shekara biyu, Malam Bagudu ya rasu. Mutane da yawa suka zo jana'izarsa: manoma, 'yan kasuwa, tsofaffin 'yan kokawa da yara. Bayan jana'izar, Zaharaddeen ya tsaya a gaban jama'a, ya ce, "Kakana ya dasa itatuwa duk rayuwarsa. Ina roƙon kowa ya dasa itace ɗaya a bakin kogi domin tunawa da shi."

Saboda tsabar ƙaunar da suke yi masa, kowa ya yarda. A wannan rana an dasa itatuwa ɗari a bakin kogi. Yanzu, idan lemun tsami ya nuna, yara suna tsinkar 'ya'yansa, suna cewa, "Wannan itacen Malam Bagudu ne."

Tambayoyi:
Me Malam Bagudu ya shahara a kai tun yana matashi?
Ya shahara a kokawa.
Me yake bayyane a kan hannayensa yanzu?
Jijiyoyi suna bayyane a kan hannayensa.
Me ya yi da Ummusalma ta haihu?
Ya dasa ƙaramar bishiyar lemun tsami a bakin kogi.
Ina Zaharaddeen yake zama kowace yamma?
Yakan zauna a wata mashaya a bakin tashar mota.
Me mutane suka yi bayan jana'izar Malam Bagudu?
Kowa ya dasa itace ɗaya a bakin kogi domin tunawa da shi.
